reason: Classified as an external-services integration plugin because its primary user-facing purpose is operating Jenkins from DeepSeek Harness, via server configuration, per-workspace run-job UI, and build/status tooling; this is directly supported by its settings page, workspace modal actions, and model tools for build/status.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 Jenkins 集成插件，用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置多个 Jenkins 服务器并在工作区触发参数化构建、查询构建状态与历史。
summaries.en: This is a Jenkins integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets users configure multiple Jenkins servers and run parameterized jobs from workspace actions with build-status and history visibility.

reasons.code: Provides a settings page for multiple Jenkins servers and stores server config, including token fields, in plugin settings.
Exposes UI and model-facing entry points to run Jenkins jobs and check build status, including queue/build/result polling.
Implements Jenkins access via host-side HTTP calls through shell-based curl commands with credentials and CSRF handling.
Supports workspace-level config files (json/js/ts) that drive which jobs/servers can be selected in the run modal.
